           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO TAXABLE-INCOME

               COMPUTE CALCULATED-TAX = TAXABLE-INCOME * 0.10
           ELSE
               IF TAXABLE-INCOME <= 44725.00

                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.
